name: Welcome Home
source: What if, one day, a character you created gains its own consciousness and thoughts, becoming deeply tormented and obsessed with reuniting with its creator, to the point of dragging you into its world? You are then forced to either find a way to escape or accept living with the consequences.
translation: What if, one day, a character you created gains its own consciousness and thoughts, becoming deeply tormented and obsessed with reuniting with its creator, to the point of dragging you into its world?
